reviews.title: eception
reviews.text:
I am very disappointed with your app because everything looks so great in your advertisements. You make it seem like you can simply open the app and have a personal tutor who talks to you naturally, corrects your mistakes, and helps you learn through real-life conversations, without having to press any buttons.

But when you actually download the app, it turns out that it doesn’t work that way at all. You constantly have to press and hold the microphone button every time you want to say something.

This is extremely inconvenient, especially when I’m driving or busy doing something else. I don’t want to have to stop what I’m doing, focus on my phone, and keep pressing buttons just to have a conversation.

What I want is to be able to sit at my computer, put my phone next to me, open the app, and simply start talking to my AI tutor naturally, without constantly touching the screen or pressing the microphone button.

That’s exactly how you advertise your app, but that’s not how it actually works.

In short, the app does not live up to what you promise in your advertisements. I feel misled and deceived. You’re misleading people with advertising that doesn’t reflect the actual experience. This is very disappointing!

reviews.title: There is not Tamil in the native language list
reviews.text:
I am absolutely disappointed and frustrated by the extremely limited language options available. Why am I being asked to select my language when Tamil is not even included?

Tamil is one of the world’s oldest living languages, spoken by millions of people worldwide. Excluding such a widely spoken and historically significant language is unacceptable.

Why are only a handful of languages being recognised? Language diversity should be respected, and everyone deserves equal representation.

This is deeply disappointing, and I strongly urge you to review your language options and include Tamil.

reviews.title: deception.
reviews.text:
The advertisement clearly states that the app is completely free and that there is nothing to pay. However, after installing it, you find out that only a 7-day free trial is offered, after which a paid subscription begins and you are charged.

The advertisement does not clearly mention this at all — there is no proper warning about the limited free trial or the charges that follow. In my opinion, this is misleading advertising. If the app becomes paid after the trial period, this should be stated clearly and honestly from the beginning, instead of giving users the impression that the app is completely free.

reviews.title: cancelation impossible
reviews.text:
I am extremely dissatisfied with Learna AI’s cancellation process. It is unnecessarily difficult and sends customers through multiple loops without providing a clear, straightforward way to cancel a subscription.

I attempted to cancel through the platform but could not find an effective cancellation option. When I reached out by email for assistance, I was told that the person responding could not support me with the cancellation. This left me being redirected without a resolution while the subscription remained active.

Customers should be able to cancel a subscription as easily as they can sign up for one. A cancellation request should not require multiple emails, searching through different screens, or being passed between support channels.

I strongly recommend that Learna AI add a clearly visible Cancel Subscription option within account settings and ensure that customer support representatives can immediately process or escalate cancellation requests.

My experience has been frustrating enough that it has negatively affected my overall opinion of the platform. The cancellation process should be transparent, simple, and respectful of customers’ time.

reviews.title: Issue With Free Trial
reviews.text:
One star because of the scam that was run on me. 

I downloaded this app despite having Duolingo because it claimed it was 100% free in the ad I saw. Upon creating an account I then saw it’s only free for a week trial so I immediately canceled the subscription and used it a few times during that week. Since it was still on my phone after the trial I decided to open the app and see if there was any portion you could use for free. There was no prompt about resubscribing or any other indication that I was now going to be charged for this app. It was also not listed in my “active subscription” area of my iPhone. I was quite surprised when I saw a charge I didn’t recognize and then finding out it was for Learna. Apple’s App Store “customer service” has been absolute trash and I’m told there’s nothing a human can do about this charge now after my initial dispute was handled by their automated system. I’m not sure if Learna or Apple’s App Store is the problem for this charge, but just know, you can be charged for a “re subscription” even when you never consent to this. Highly disappointed in this interaction and have disputed the charge with my credit card company and filed a complaint with the NYS Attorneys General.

reviews.title: Had problems with very first lesson
reviews.text:
Setting up the app I noticed some minor broken English. Not enough that I couldn't understand but just enough to make me wonder. If you can't speak my native language proficiently, what makes me think you could teach me another? But I carried on. 

Very first lesson I'm learning the imperfect tense in Spanish which I already know but I figure it will be a great place to see if the app is worthwhile. At some point the AI says "leía la pelota" means "I used to read the ball" true or false? 

That sentence doesn't make much sense but yes the translation is correct so I said true. AI said it was false because I used to read the ball doesn't make much sense. 

I responded that no it does not make much sense but the translation you said was correct. I think it was trying to ask if "leía" was the correct verb for that sentence and I would've said no that it was probably going for something like "jugaba" but yeah I just realized really quickly that me and this thing we're not going to be simpatico

reviews.title: Be very careful with this app.
reviews.text:
Be very careful with this app.

I subscribed through their website and was then redirected to the app. I assumed it was a single subscription, but it turned out they effectively create TWO subscriptions — one through the website and one through the app.

I canceled the subscription in the app before the renewal date, but I was still charged weekly through another (hidden) subscription.

This feels like a very misleading and unfair setup. Instead of a transparent process, I had to deal with support, my bank, and multiple steps just to stop being charged.

I spent a lot of time and stress trying to fix this.

Very disappointed with this experience. I do not recommend using this service

reviews.title: Cancel my membership
reviews.text:
I strongly advise everyone to stay away from Learna AI.

I made the mistake of subscribing after seeing what looked like a perfect advertisement. Within the first 5 minutes of using the app, I already regretted my decision.

There is no clear or easy way to cancel the membership. Despite multiple attempts and emails asking them to unsubscribe me, they continue charging my account.

Even more concerning — after sharing my bank details with them, I started noticing unusual charges. This raised serious red flags, and I had to report the issue to my bank.

This has been a frustrating and stressful experience. Please be careful and do your research before signing up. Don’t make the same mistake I did.

reviews.title: i don’t recommend
reviews.text:
I want to let people know about my experience with the Learna AI app. The app makes it seem like you can use it for free, which is one of the main reasons I decided to download it in the first place. I was simply trying to learn Spanish and thought it would be a helpful tool.

However, after opening the app, it required me to start a free trial before I could actually use most of the features. I did not realize that using the app would involve starting a subscription trial, and I was not planning on paying for anything. Because of this, I felt uncomfortable continuing to use the app.

I logged out of the app because I was unsure how to cancel the trial or manage the subscription. For anyone thinking about downloading it, I would recommend being careful and reading the details about the trial before signing up. If you are just looking for a completely free way to learn Spanish, this app may not be the best option.

reviews.title: American accent
reviews.text: May be silly but I can’t seem to change the accent to English and I find her American accent a bit harsh and off putting. I’m fighting through, and asked her to speak more slowly in Spanish but she doesn’t when speaking in sentences (when I need it) only when saying the actual word. Feels too gamified for me… like how Duolingo has become. Also feel I can work through the program OK but don’t feel i have learnt anything- this may well be my more specific learning issues than this programme. It feels if you find learning languages easy this might be good for you. I don’t feels it’s somehow unlocked my difficulties- probably not the issue of the app!

reviews.text:
⸻

⚠️ Warning before subscribing ⚠️
Be very careful with this app. The subscription is extremely difficult to cancel. There is no clear or easy cancellation option inside the app, and you are required to contact support by email, which causes delays.

The price is also very high – $25 per week, and the subscription renews automatically.
I strongly recommend reading everything carefully before subscribing, as canceling is not straightforward.

reviews.title: No challenge
reviews.text: It started off too easy, but then when you do get to info you are just learning it goes too fast. I ask to repeat a section it sometimes goes back but seems in a hurry to press on without time to really repeat and understand. It is a machine that facilitates language learning but doesn’t really account for the human experiences. It is nice to have conversation unlike other apps but repeating, questioning, reinforcing in the moment are important.

reviews.title: Paid $80 to learn nothing
reviews.text:
Used for less than two days and somehow ended up locked into an $80 one-year subscription. Impressive, in the worst way.
Each lesson is mostly recycled content, repeated again and again until any actual learning disappears. The “feedback” after every class is copy-paste generic, adding nothing except more wasted time.
Refund was refused, and customer service was dismissive and unhelpful. Great app if you enjoy paying to listen to the same thing repeatedly. Not recommended if you value your time or money.

reviews.title: Scammers
reviews.text: I’ve never been so furious with a subscription in my life. This app charged me without making it clear at all, and I never knowingly agreed to pay that amount. I feel completely taken advantage of. The way the app handles payments feels sneaky and dishonest, and I wish I had never downloaded it. And to make the situation even worse, Apple refused my refund request. I was shocked — I didn’t even get a proper chance to cancel before being charged. It feels like nobody cares about the customer at all. I trusted this app, and instead I ended up losing money and time. I want others to know what happened to me so they don’t fall into the same trap. Be very careful, and don’t make the same mistake I did.
